name: Echoes of Undeath
description:
About This Game

Last Monster Slayers in a world drowning in darkness.

Echoes of Undeath is a gothic, third-person survival action game inspired by classics like Dark Souls, Castlevania, and Vampire Survivors — survive endless waves of demons and undead, master brutal souls-like combat, and unlock forbidden powers.

⚔️ Key Features:

  • Hack and slash hordes of skeletons, demons, and eldritch horrors

  • Wield swords, axes, and devastating magical sigils

  • Level up to gain new spells and passive powers

  • Face a relentless onslaught — how long can you survive?

  • Atmospheric dark fantasy world with rich VFX and haunting music

  • Planned online co-op mode: slay together with friends!

Early Access Roadmap:

  • New weapons, maps, and enemies

  • More spells and combat styles

  • Full co-op mode and community-driven features

Prepare to face your nightmares. How long will you last before you join the legion of the undead?
short_desc: Echoes of Undeath is an RPG survival action game. Inspired by Dark Souls and Vampire Survivors. Fight endless waves of monsters! Master brutal combat, unlock forbidden powers, prove yourselves by killing Hard Core, Bosses, and survive to learn more about the world and the story of forgotten power.
